name: Berger Paints India Limited
summary: Berger Paints India Limited manufactures and sells paints in India and internationally. The company offers interior wall coatings, including designer finishes, interior emulsions, and ceiling paints; exterior wall coatings comprising exterior emulsions and textures, and roof and floor coatings; putty and cement paints; solvent, interior, exterior, metal, and wood primers; enamels; wood finishes; waterproofing solutions; and tiling solutions. It also provides acrylic, silicate, and mineral plasters; thermal insulation adhesives; mortars; ready to use coat, wood effect, ribbed effect, concrete effect, and 3D effect; gel adhesives for ceramic tile flooring.
